title: PMV experiment ledger checkpoint, version 1
description: One line of research/experiment-ledger-checkpoints.v1.jsonl: an anchor (ledger_seq, entry_sha256) that the ledger must still contain. ledger_seq strictly increases from line to line. Checkpoints are appended by ExperimentStore.append_checkpoint() and never committed automatically; committing the file is an explicit operator action. Documentation only: the authoritative validators are pmv.experiment_ledger.parse_checkpoints and verify_checkpoints. Canonical bytes: sorted keys, no spaces, ASCII, no floats, one trailing newline. JSON booleans are never integers.

timestamp.description: UTC; must also be a real calendar time
